Mandatory Enclosure

Affiliation, recognition and teaching staff information.

School affiliation

TSG Gurukul lists CBSE affiliation number 1530163 through senior secondary level and recognition by the Government of Odisha. The school also lists a CHSE-affiliated wing and B.Sc. and B.Com. programmes affiliated with Utkal University.
